listing.summary: Upstream reports menus and Instant Action/co-op loading, but 3D output is black. The campaign menu starts; mission startup remains unfinished. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA or Europe Xbox 360 game, title ID 555307D5. This guide has only an abbreviated default.xex SHA-256, 295ac4de...c023a; check the full upstream requirement before setup. Keep the main, multiplayer and campaign executables together as one game installation.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s extraction and build scripts for port, port-mp and port-yeti. No release package is confirmed; use the source-build instructions.
